meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Drives dependency-ordered child work through the native workflow tool, one run per phase with retry/amend/send recovery. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把互相依赖的一批任务按阶段依次跑完,失败自动重试接管
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果有一堆有先后依赖的任务需要按顺序自动跑完
copy.tagline_en: Run a batch of dependency-ordered tasks phase by phase, retrying failures automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a set of tasks with dependencies must run automatically in order

howto.what: 把有依赖关系的多任务拆成一张节点图:每个节点有自己的提示词和类别,按依赖分批并行执行,完成情况要凭证据核验,不是节点报完就算完。一次运行只覆盖一个阶段;某个节点失败可单独重试、发消息或改定义重跑,已完成节点的结果会保留。
howto.when: 当你提到 “mass-ulw”、“DAG” 等关键词,或需要让某些任务等前置任务完成后才执行时触发。完全独立的任务用普通并行更简单。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw 把这批任务排成有依赖的图并跑起来
say.note: 会先读规划文档,再定义节点图

say.text: 重试 verify 节点,并把提示词改成只检查链接
say.note: 只重跑该节点及其下游

say.text: 给正在跑的 rewrite 节点发消息:只改 docs/ 下的文件

howto.what_en: Turns dependent multi-task requests into a node graph: nodes run in waves as dependencies clear, completion must be proven by evidence, and one run covers one phase. Failed nodes can be retried, steered, or amended.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention mass-ulw, a DAG, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others. Fully independent tasks are simpler with plain parallel task spawns.

say_en.text: Use mass-ulw to turn these tasks into a dependency graph and run it
say_en.note: Reads the planning doc, then defines the nodes

say_en.text: Retry the verify node and change its prompt to only check links
say_en.note: Only that node and its dependents re-run

say_en.text: Send the running rewrite node: only edit files under docs/
